sentences.text: Finally, the Inland rules add a few definitions of their own.
Inland waters are the navigable waters of the United States shoreward of the demarcation lines.
The Great Lakes include their connecting and tributary waters.
The Western Rivers are the Mississippi River system, including the Atchafalaya and the Red River.
When a question mentions any of these places, expect a special rule.
You may never run a charter on the Mississippi, but the exam will still ask about it.
Next, we’ll put it to work with the duties every vessel has in any visibility: lookout, safe speed, and judging the risk of collision.
